summary: ST-03 is a story with children: [] and no workitems/ directory: an empty story, which the planning contract requires expanded before acceptance. Its own scope inventory confirms this is not a leaf (15-24 organisms across 4 named subsystems; at least 15 per-species signature-rule behaviors plus large-scale event staging, far over the three-responsibility leaf limit), and its criteria (AC-roster-count, AC-roster-behavior, AC-roster-large, AC-roster-tests) currently have no child coverage. Findings are otherwise sound: dependencies on ST-01 and ST-02 resolve, criteria are written as a cleanly partitionable floor, and the spoiler/section-11.2/68 constraints are carried. Required split: adopt the node's own size-tier boundary (ambient/schools, small/medium, predators/territorial, huge/colossal set pieces), each tier one child work item with its own headless scenario tests; the colossal tier may need a second split because its staging overlaps ST-04. Do not mix the alternative macro-band split. When splitting, partition AC-roster-count per tier, place AC-roster-large (colossal presence + no-clean-view encounter) on the huge/colossal child(ren), and keep AC-roster-tests in every child with one named final proof owner for the full-roster test and spoiler audit; all children inherit depends_on [ST-01, ST-02] and the ids they introduce must be stable before ST-04 splits.
